How to read the guides

Listing statements are attributed to their original sources and may come from cached extracts. A review date is not a live price or inventory check. Missing measurements and conflicting fields stay visible.

The site owner's fabric clarification applies to the Fesciory black necklace B0D9GWX6L6 only. It is not applied to the separate wrap-bracelet products.

Prices remain historical research references, not FUBAO selling prices. Images are AI-styled from matched source photos and do not prove material, sizing or included quantities.
